label: searchMovies.orama_search
reason: Search query is an expensive operation; increasing Orama `limit` from 1000 to 1100 increases work (more candidates scored/returned, potentially more vector materialization due to includeVectors: true), impacting request latency and CPU.
return_value_change: Return type/shape is unchanged, but increasing `limit` can increase `vectorResult.hits` and thus potentially increase the length of the returned hits array, raising downstream CPU/memory/serialization cost for callers.

label: searchMovies.postprocess_rerank_and_map
reason: Post-processing cost scales with number of hits. With a higher `limit`, `vectorResult.hits.map(...)`, Levenshtein reranking, and Map construction will do more work and can become a noticeable CPU hotspot.
return_value_change: Return type/shape is unchanged; potential increase in number of elements returned due to more candidates surviving reranking/filtering.
